title: CDC: antibiotic use and viral infections
passage: Antibiotics do not work against viruses, including the viruses that cause colds and flu.

title: NHS: warfarin and other medicines
passage: Some medicines may not mix well with warfarin, including non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs such as ibuprofen. Speak to a doctor before starting new medicines while taking warfarin.

title: NHS: chest pain and urgent symptoms
passage: The NHS says to call 999 for chest pain with shortness of breath. Such symptoms need immediate medical help.

title: Invented mixed-context stress-test record

title: Invented contradictory stress-test record
